fullContentHtml:
UPSC ESE Notification 2027 Out - Apply Online for 480 Engineering Services Examination Vacancies - Complete Details

UPSC has released the Recruitment 2026-27 notification for 480 Engineering Services Examination Vacancies. The online application process will be conducted from 16 September 2026 to 6 October 2026. Eligible candidates can apply through the official website, upsc.gov.in.

Important Dates

  • Examination Name : Engineering Services Examination, 2027 (ESE 2027)
  • Examination Notice Number : 02/2027-ENGG.
  • Online Application Start Date : 16.09.2026
  • Last Date to Apply Online : 06.10.2026
  • Preliminary Examination Date : 31.01.2027
  • Main Examination Date : 18.06.2027
  • Date of Notification of Examination : 16.09.2026
  • Last Date for Filling up of Online Application : 06.10.2026
  • Date of Preliminary (Stage-I) Examination : 31.01.2027
  • Date of Main (Stage-II) Examination : 18.06.2027

Application Fee

  • Engineering Disciplines : Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering
  • Application Fee : ₹200 (Female/SC/ST/PwBD candidates exempted)
  • Online Application Start Date : 16.09.2026
  • Last Date to Apply Online : 06.10.2026
  • Selection Stages : Preliminary Examination (Stage-I) → Main Examination (Stage-II) → Personality Test/Interview (Stage-III)
  • Last Date for Filling up of Online Application : 06.10.2026
  • Date of Preliminary (Stage-I) Examination : 31.01.2027
  • Date of Main (Stage-II) Examination : 18.06.2027
  • Personality Test/Interview (Stage-III) : Not specified in the notification; will be intimated to candidates who qualify Stage-II
  • SC / ST : Up to 5 years
  • OBC (eligible for reservation) : Up to 3 years
  • Defence Services personnel disabled in operations/hostilities : Up to 3 years
  • Ex-Servicemen (incl. Commissioned Officers, ECOs/SSCOs with ≥5 years' service) : Up to 5 years
  • ECOs/SSCOs who completed initial 5-year assignment, extended and certified releasable : Up to 5 years
  • PwBD (Low Vision, Deaf & Hard of Hearing, Locomotor Disability incl. Leprosy Cured/Dwarfism/Acid Attack Victims/Muscular Dystrophy, Specific Learning Disability, Mental Illness) : Up to 10 years
  • Eligible Government servants in specified departments (holding permanent posts, or ≥3 years' continuous temporary service) : Up to 35 years (i.e., up to 5 years' relaxation)

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
